name: Form of the Half—dragon, Mythic
body:
School transmutation (polymorph); Level alchemist 5, arcanist/sorcerer/wizard 5, investigator 5, magus 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a scale of the dragon type you plan to assume)

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 min./level (D)
Saving Throw see below; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You become a humanoid dragon of your same size. You gain a +2 size bonus to Strength, a +2 natural armor bonus, fly 60 feet (poor), darkvision 30 feet, a breath weapon, and resistance 10 to one element. You also gain one bite (1d6), two claws (1d6), and two wing attacks (1d4). Your breath weapon type and shape and the element you gain resistance against depend on the type of dragon you selected (see the various form of the dragon spells). You can only use your breath weapon once per casting of this spell. All breath weapons deal 4d8 points of damage and allow a Reflex save for half damage.
